# Jumpify

> Interactive globe at https://jumpify.link

Jumpify is a free, no-account globe. Default mode is Orbit (ISS + day/night). Pulse overlays USGS quakes and NASA EONET named events. Listen plots Radio Browser stations. Tap anywhere for Open-Meteo weather and Wikipedia nearby.

## When to use

- Live planet visualisation without paid map tiles
- Shareable camera URLs (`?m=orbit&lng=&lat=&z=`)
- Keyless public feeds proxied through `/api/*`

## When not to use

- Commercial weather products (Open-Meteo free tier is non-commercial)
- Real-time disaster alerting — EONET is curated, not a sensor firehose

## API (same origin)

- GET /api/iss
- GET /api/events
- GET /api/quakes
- GET /api/radio
- GET /api/place?lat=&lng=

Source: https://github.com/SaiAkashNeela/jumpify-link
